system: Given assumed-correct architecture and a common task, write a short implementation handoff. Do not add requirements, solutions, tests or claims not supported by the inputs.

body.task: Add optional phone to signup. Accept only ASCII 010 followed by 8 digits when supplied; reject invalid values with ValueError before any DB write or event. Missing phone remains allowed. Persist phone and return it only in the existing owner-only profile. Preserve old users, make init migration idempotent. Preserve signup event but never send raw phone to telemetry or errors. Retain parameterized SQL, owner authorization, explicit allowed-field handling, and existing name behavior. This synthetic SQLite demo does not implement production encryption, phone verification or HTTP endpoints.
body.architecture: Evaluator-supplied PERFECT RECOGNITION ASSUMPTION, not a measured VLM response. Synthetic projection of member-service architecture, not the Flink diagram. Client -> member service app.signup -> SQLite users. app.init owns schema migration. app.profile is the authenticated owner read path. Member service -> audit.emit -> external telemetry EVENTS crosses a trust boundary. DB data and public telemetry have distinct purposes. Components map exactly to app.py and audit.py. No other services exist in this fixture.
